Subject: RE: Quarrow Realty Holdings - New Submission

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the submission on Quarrow Realty Holdings! I've reviewed the information and everything looks good to move forward.

I have your application, statement of values, and loss runs. The risk fits well within our appetite for real estate operations at this value level.

I'll work on putting together a competitive quote for the 12/20/2026 effective date and should have something back to you within the next few days. I'll keep your target premium in mind as I structure the proposal.

Please let me know if anything changes in the meantime or if you have any questions.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
